<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:6">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>טִימִיתֵיה</he> (not … <he>תי</he>) the money received for it; a. fr.—Also: <cite ref="I00382"><he>טִימִין</he></cite> (accus. of τιμή).
